Exact arithmetic verifies one negative finite quadratic form -49/243; finite checks are not used for infinite necessity.

value.rationale: A natural covariance-kernel problem on regular trees requires positivity for every finite vertex set and arbitrarily many harmonic modes. An exact sharp radius below which all oscillation phases work, followed by a two-component allowable phase set and a singular boundary, resolves the complete parameter question and exhibits a branching-specific topological change in the admissible region. This is a motivated structural phase classification, not a parameter sample or routine numerical check.
